rows.en:
(I came to do EX-Gear training
with Yuuto today, but...)

Sorry to keep you waiting,
\p.

Getting the EX-Gear ready takes time.
It can't be helped.
Well then, shall we go for a quick flight?
Let's do that.

This just isn't going well...
What am I doing wrong?

From what I can see, you're still not
fully riding the wind.

That way you burn fuel and you don't
accelerate either. Nothing good comes of it.

I'll do one flight myself,
so watch me from below.
Okay, got it!

(I came to do EX-Gear training
with Kagura-kun today, but...)
Yeah!

This just isn't going well...
What am I doing wrong?
I see... It's hard.

(I came to do EX-Gear training
with Yuuto again today.)

Well, EX-Gear prep takes time.
It can't be helped.

Right. Let's not waste time,
and get started.
I'm gonna give it my all!

You're really getting the hang of it,
aren't you?

You think so?
Hearing that from you, Yuuto,
gives me confidence.

Then let's do one more run
before you forget the feel of it.
Roger!!

(I came to do EX-Gear training
with Kagura-kun again today.)

You think so?
Hearing that from you, Kagura-kun,
gives me confidence.

(I came to Griffith Park
with Yuuto today.)

...I don't come here much,
but it's a nice view.

Yeah, the sunset from here
is something special.
Mind if I watch it for a while?
Of course.
It's gotten pretty late, huh.

Sorry for making you
stick around with me...

I wanted to watch it too,
so don't worry about it.
That's a relief to hear.
Well then, let's head home for today.

(I came to Griffith Park
with Kagura-kun today.)

Yeah, the sunset from here
is really lovely.

I wanted to watch it too,
so don't worry about it.
I see. That's a relief to hear.

Okay then, let's call it a day
and head home.

(I came to Griffith Park
with Yuuto again today.)

...It's a nice view here,
no matter when you come.

Yeah, it's perfect for when you need
to think things over.
Mind if I watch it for a while again?

Shall we head home soon,
\p?
Huh, you're done already?
Yeah, I've got my thoughts sorted out.
Well then, shall we go?

(I wonder if Yuuto has a lot
on his mind too?)

(I came to Griffith Park
with Kagura-kun again today.)

Yeah, it's perfect for when you need
to think things over.

(I wonder if Kagura-kun has a lot
on his mind too?)

(I'm studying in the library
with Yuuto today.)
All right, let's hit the books hard today!
Hey, you're being too loud...
Oops, sorry...

Let's pull ourselves together
and do our best!!

Haah... I've read so much,
my eyes are seeing spots...

Yeah...
I haven't studied this much since
the entrance exams, either.
rows.notes: The Japanese has a typo (irai 'request' for irai 'since'); read as 'since the entrance exams'.

rows.en:
Studying really goes faster
with two people, huh.

This kind of thing isn't bad
once in a while.

Well, let's grab a bite
before we head home.

(I'm tired, but I got some
good studying done today.)

(I'm studying in the library
with Kagura-kun today.)

Studying really goes faster
with two people, huh.

Yeah, this kind of thing isn't bad
once in a while.

(I'm tired, but I got some
good studying done today.)

(I'm studying in the library
with Yuuto again today.)

All right, let's hit the books hard
again today!
Oops, sorry... Sorry.

Haah... I've stared at so many numbers,
my head's getting all tangled up...

Yeah...
I can't even tell what the right answer
is anymore...

Looks like we'd better take a break
from this.

Let's try again another day.
I can't take any more today!
You think so?

Let's eat something and go home!
There's nothing else for it!!

(I'm studying in the library
with Kagura-kun again today.)

uncertain: c07571: the Japanese has a typo (the kanji for 'request' instead of 'since'); read as 'since the entrance exams'.
c07525 'un!' (x17: female player here, also Pinon and Ranka in several scenes) rendered 'Yeah!' to suit every speaker.
c07587 'sou kana?' (x7: player, Ranka) rendered 'You think so?', matching c07460; in frd_kgr_111 it answers Kagura's overblown 'I can't take any more today!'.
c07546 is shared by Kagura (frd_kgr_110) and the male player (frd_luk_115): 'That's a relief to hear.' fits both.
c07516/c07529: Kagura apologises for the wait; the player blames the EX-Gear prep without saying whose gear it was ('Getting the EX-Gear ready takes time').
c07535 'ryoukai!!' rendered 'Roger!!', in line with c07470 'Roger~'.
